title: Pool_Exhaustion banner branch (and the r4-shortened pool title) has zero blessed pixel coverage — every banner-bearing T2 pins only Saturated_Bundle
detail: The r4 rework shortened the pool banner title, but no golden-suite capture shows a Pool_Exhaustion crisis: pool_max_packets=512 is unreachable in every demo, so every banner-bearing T2 pins only Saturated_Bundle. The shortened title's fit in card_w=440 stays unverified.
recommended_fix: Bless one pool-crisis T2 capture: a surge-window demo with a small pool cap (the pool_max_packets=10 shape of test_crisis_pool_fires_on_routed_delivering_network) so the pool branch renders and the title's card fit is pixel-pinned.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: P0 100%: trigger/root-cause/dedup unit-pinned, warn.t1 hashes the per-tick event stream, T2 pins the banner. P1 ≥90%: resolve/re-trigger surge brackets, AC-E13, replay gate. Overall ≥80%. One P2 gap (pool-banner pixels) does not drop the gate.
recommended_fix: Close the single P2 gap (bless a pool-crisis T2 capture with a small-cap catalog) to make every crisis render branch pixel-pinned; the gate then PASSes with zero gaps.
